stemMd: A positive integer has exactly three positive divisors. Which form must it have?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The product of two distinct primes

options.label: D
options.textMd: The square of a prime number

options.label: E
options.textMd: The cube of a prime number

explanationMd: A prime square p squared has divisors 1,p,p squared. The divisor-count formula shows that a total of three requires one prime exponent of two, since three is prime.

distractorRationale.c: Even integers can have many different divisor counts.
